ui-devices.directAddress: Direct address of the outside face
ui-devices.failures: Note: someone typed a wrong pairing code recently ({count, plural, one {# time} other {# times}}). If it was not you, check the audit.
ui-devices.failuresLocked: Note: someone typed a wrong pairing code recently ({count, plural, one {# time} other {# times}}; pairing is paused for some sources, see above). If it was not you, check the audit.
ui-devices.howByHand: No link or QR code: type the pairing code on the device by hand.
ui-devices.howScan: Scan the code with the other device, or open the outside face's page in its browser, choose "Connect with a pairing code" on the sign-in page and type it.
ui-devices.intro: Paired devices (a phone's browser, say) open this page as you through the outside face (direct or through the relay): they can see sessions and answer cards. Pairing and revoking both need the PIN; a revoke takes effect at once. Resetting the PIN ends every device.
ui-devices.lock.relayUnknown: A source through the relay (the relay gave no address)
ui-devices.locked: {source} typed wrong pairing codes too often: pairing from there is paused until {until}. Pairing from anywhere else still works.
ui-devices.pairName: Name (optional; the device's browser name otherwise)
ui-devices.pairPin: A pairing code lets another device connect as you.
ui-devices.revokePin: Revoke "{name}": it can no longer connect, starting now.
ui-devices.revokeThisPin: Revoke this device: this page signs out at once.
ui-devices.title: Devices
ui-devices.viaRelayFrom: through the relay (source the relay reported: {ip})
